title: The Community of the First Transgression
intro: In the land of ancient cities, a people once thrived. They were visited by a messenger with a clear call, yet they turned away and pursued a path no one had ever walked. Their tale is one of defiance, depravity, and a punishment that left their homeland as a sign for all who reflect. Who are these souls?
clues: We lived in cities of the plain, where our prophet called us to righteousness.
We were the first to commit an indecency that no one in all the worlds had ever done before.
We waylaid travelers and committed evil openly in our gatherings.
We rejected the messenger sent to us and threatened to drive him out of our land.
We rushed to his house demanding he surrender his guests to us.
Our punishment was a rain of stones, and our city was turned upside down.
